why_ai: Licensed vets examine, diagnose and operate on animals in person across dozens of species.
why_clarity: Wellness visits recur, but multi-species diagnosis varies by clinician and outcomes are often uncertain.
why_digital: Care is delivered hands-on in local clinics to clients who bring their pets in.

why_ai: State veterinarians hold legal authority for quarantine and movement control during novel outbreaks.
why_clarity: Lab confirmation is objective, but each outbreak investigation unfolds differently.
why_digital: Field sampling and lab work feed government reporting under state and federal programmes.

why_ai: Regulatory submissions and safety signals carry accountable sign-off, with animal studies run at physical sites.
why_clarity: Study protocols and submission formats are codified, but approvals take years.
why_digital: Study data and adverse event reports analysed and submitted electronically.

why_ai: The owner-vet personally examines, treats and operates on pets under licence.
why_clarity: Vaccinations and wellness exams repeat, but diagnosis and treatment vary by case.
why_digital: Hands-on exam-room and surgical care for local clients.

why_ai: Thousands of hospitals still deliver licensed hands-on care; only the corporate layer is automatable.
why_clarity: Standardised protocols and provider benchmarks make care more uniform across hospitals.
why_digital: Care remains in-person at local hospitals, with standardised systems behind it.

why_ai: Radiograph reading is well-defined visual pattern recognition, already served by AI read products.
why_clarity: Reads are benchmarked against board-certified radiologist interpretations across large volumes.
why_digital: Digital radiographs read on screen, often by remote teleradiology services.

why_ai: Each species has unique physiology and thin references, so licensed hands-on care is novel every case.
why_clarity: Few established reference ranges or formularies exist for reptiles, birds and small mammals.
why_digital: Exams and treatment are in person at the clinic.

why_ai: Vets drive to barns for lameness exams, reproduction work and field surgery.
why_clarity: Herd health routines recur, but field cases and lameness evaluation rely on feel.
why_digital: Farm calls in rural areas with paper notes and poor connectivity.

why_ai: Licensed vets perform high-volume spay and neuter surgery by hand.
why_clarity: Standardised surgeries repeat at volume and success is counted in animals served.
why_digital: In-person surgery for local underserved communities, with paper records.

why_ai: The only vet for miles handles pets and livestock on farms and in clinic under licence.
why_clarity: Dual-species caseloads mean varied cases, from vaccines to emergency C-sections.
why_digital: Hands-on care across clinic and farm calls in low-connectivity rural areas.

why_ai: Actuarial pricing and claim adjudication are data-driven, under insurance regulation and actuarial sign-off.
why_clarity: Rating and adjudication rules apply to millions of claims, while loss ratios emerge over time.
why_digital: Invoices and claims processed online for remote policyholders.

why_ai: Chronic refill tracking and reminders are structured, predictable workflows software runs.
why_clarity: Each refill is due on a known date and is either fulfilled or lapses.
why_digital: Prescription records and reminders are digital; medication is dispensed or shipped physically.

why_ai: Expert-panel consensus carries the authority practices and corporate groups adopt as protocol.
why_clarity: Guidelines rest on expert consensus where evidence is thin, and effects are rarely measured.
why_digital: Panels meet and publish guidelines digitally, with accreditation site reviews.

why_ai: Assortment, pricing and demand forecasting over order data are standard automated analytics.
why_clarity: Forecasts and pricing are checked against order flow every cycle.
why_digital: Order-level purchasing data analysed internally on screen.

why_ai: Association standing gives credibility, but survey analysis and reporting are automatable.
why_clarity: Workforce supply and demand models cannot be checked until years pass.
why_digital: Surveys and licensure data analysed and published digitally.

why_ai: The sole accepted licensure exam operates under state authority, with proctored testing in person.
why_clarity: Psychometric standards define item performance and pass or fail for each candidate.
why_digital: Item banks are digital, with exams delivered at proctored test centres.

why_ai: Pricing, productivity and retention modelling over medical records is analytics AI performs.
why_clarity: Productivity and retention metrics recur quarterly, though protocol effects take longer.
why_digital: Medical records and invoices analysed inside corporate data teams.

why_ai: Lending decisions and transaction advice rely on accountable credit staff and seller relationships.
why_clarity: Valuations follow multiple-based methods, and loans perform or default post-close.
why_digital: Financials analysed on screen; deals sourced through relationships with practice owners.

why_ai: Benchmark reports and reminder modelling are platform analytics features AI produces.
why_clarity: Visit volume, pricing and compliance are counted from records continuously.
why_digital: Practice records aggregated and delivered as software and reports.

why_ai: Physical samples need lab analysers and pathologist cytology reads; demand is unaffected by AI.
why_clarity: Assays produce numeric results against validated reference intervals.
why_digital: Couriered physical samples in, digital results out, sold with in-clinic analysers.

why_ai: Board-certified specialists perform high-acuity surgery and critical care in person.
why_clarity: Complex cases vary widely, though complications and outcomes are recorded.
why_digital: In-person specialty and emergency care for pets referred by local GPs.
